tasks.scope: Non-destructive exact-local boot preflight that never kills, stops, repairs or restarts an existing session or daemon, bounded readiness capture, and no forced submit or retry on dispatch are included; bound delivery of a qualified-busy non-spawned --target through telepty inject-bound-v1, pinned to one session epoch and owner generation, is included and reports ACCEPTED_PENDING, which is never a verified delivery; named BOUND_INJECT_UNSUPPORTED (78) and BOUND_INJECT_REFUSED (3) refusals and a held, never-replayed unknown outcome (7) are included; the stranded-composer report prints the operator's own telepty clear-strand-v1 procedure and never clears. These paths require @dmsdc-ai/aigentry-telepty 0.11.1 or later on the daemon and on every restarted bridge. Also included are the release records: package version, lockfile, changelog, public projection, dispositions, this manifest, the security evidence blobs, the policy path and release-workflow ownership. Not established: native busy queueing or model receipt by any automated test, a real strand followed by a successful clear outside mocks, bound delivery for a collapsed one-line Claude viewport or a codex footer without the warnings suffix, and the unchanged dispatch-verify.sh set -e defect. Publication requires controller-reviewed exact policy bytes, a literal workflow pin to their SHA-256, exact integrated CI including Windows W1 and W0, then registry verification.
